body:
## Problem

Loom can drive Claude Code, Codex, Pi and OpenCode, but not [Kimi Code CLI](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/guides/getting-started.html) (Moonshot AI's terminal agent, binary `kimi`). The operator wants to run Loom work through Kimi. This is the first slice: a native Rust harness adapter so `LOOM_RUNTIME=kimi` reaches a headless `kimi` launch through the existing worker seam, plus honest admission and a live canary. Guarded tools (Builder/Doctor/Judge admission), the account pool, usage attribution and containment are separate follow-ups filed alongside this one.

Per ADR-0018 and the shell-language policy this is a Rust adapter behind `loom-daemon spawn-worker`, exactly like Pi/OpenCode (#8362) — **no new `spawn-kimi.sh`**, no tier-3 `spawn-generic.sh` wrapper (that route has no model/credential/usage integration and would be refused for every mutating role anyway).

## What Kimi Code CLI offers (from its docs, verify on the pinned version)

| Facet | Kimi Code CLI | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Install / binary | `npm install -g @moonshot-ai/kimi-code` (Node ≥ 22.19) or the vendor install script; binary `kimi`; `kimi -V` | [getting-started](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/guides/getting-started.html) |
| Headless | `kimi -p "<prompt>"` / `--prompt`; `--output-format stream-json` (NDJSON, only with `--prompt`); `-p` **implies** auto-approval and is **incompatible** with `--yolo` / `--auto` / `--plan` | [kimi command](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/reference/kimi-command.html), [print mode](https://moonshotai.github.io/kimi-cli/en/customization/print-mode.html) |
| Model | `-m/--model <alias>` where alias is a `[models.<alias>]` entry in `$KIMI_CODE_HOME/config.toml`; **or** the config-free env family `KIMI_MODEL_NAME` + `KIMI_MODEL_API_KEY` + `KIMI_MODEL_PROVIDER_TYPE` (`kimi`/`anthropic`/`openai`) + `KIMI_MODEL_BASE_URL` + `KIMI_MODEL_THINKING_EFFORT` (`low`/`medium`/`high`/`xhigh`/`max`). Precedence: CLI flags > env > config.toml | [env-vars](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/configuration/env-vars.html), [providers](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/configuration/providers.html) |
| Credentials | API keys are **not** read from ambient shell vars (only via `api_key_env` in config or the `KIMI_MODEL_*` family); OAuth via `kimi login` (device code, no TUI) writes `$KIMI_CODE_HOME/credentials/*.json` (0700/0600) | env-vars, [data-locations](https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code-cli/configuration/data-locations.html) |
| Data root | `~/.kimi-code`, relocatable with `KIMI_CODE_HOME` (config, sessions, logs, credentials all move with it) | data-locations |
| Exit codes | `0` success, `1` permanent (config / auth / quota), `75` transient (rate limit, 5xx, timeout) | print mode |
| Hygiene | `KIMI_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1`, `KIMI_CODE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1`, `KIMI_LOG_LEVEL`; `kimi doctor` validates config.toml | env-vars |
| Stdin | `--input-format=stream-json` accepts NDJSON user messages on stdin | print mode |

## Scope (this issue)

1. **Harness** — add `Harness::Kimi` to `loom-daemon/src/worker_spawn/harness.rs` (`LOOM_KIMI_BIN` override, name `kimi`, `is_native` true). Command translation: `-p <expanded prompt> --output-format stream-json`, `-m <model>` when the selection resolves to a config alias, or the `KIMI_MODEL_*` env family when the profile is an API-key profile; `KIMI_MODEL_THINKING_EFFORT` from `--effort`/profile effort, validated against Kimi's five levels (fail 78 on anything else, like Pi's thinking check). Never emit `--yolo`/`--auto` (`-p` already auto-approves and rejects them); `--dangerously-skip-permissions` is therefore a no-op for Kimi and must not error. `stdin` null unless the stdin prompt route below is adopted. Set `KIMI_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1` and `KIMI_CODE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` in the child env (same reasoning as `OPENCODE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE=1` in `docker/native/Dockerfile`).
2. **Prompt delivery vs E2BIG (#8506)** — expanded role prompts already exceed Linux `MAX_ARG_STRLEN` for Pi/OpenCode. Evaluate delivering the prompt over `--input-format=stream-json` on stdin instead of `-p` argv; if it works headless, prefer it and record the finding on #8506.
3. **Model profile binding** — `defaults/model-profiles.json` gains a `kimi` provider binding. Two example profiles, no account values: (a) Kimi Code subscription (`providers.kimi` = a config alias, no `credentialEnv` → harness's own auth store, which is the credential ladder's "no pool" case in `worker_spawn/credential.rs`); (b) Moonshot platform API key via `credentialEnv: "KIMI_API_KEY"`, `credentialTargets.kimi: "KIMI_MODEL_API_KEY"`, `providerOptions.kimi: {"providerType":"kimi","baseUrl":"https://api.moonshot.ai/v1"}` mapped to `KIMI_MODEL_PROVIDER_TYPE`/`KIMI_MODEL_BASE_URL`. Secrets travel only as env, never argv or launch record (#8402 rules).
4. **Manifest + admission** — `defaults/runtimes/kimi.json`, added to `BUNDLED_RUNTIME_MANIFESTS` in `runtime_admission.rs`. Honest values for this slice: `worktreeIsolation: "no"`, `loomControl: "no"`, `mcp: "no"` (Kimi supports MCP natively but Loom provisions none), `subagents: "no"` (Kimi's `Agent`/`AgentSwarm` tools exist but are unverified), `hooks: "no"`. Consequence: admitted only for roles declaring no `runtimeRequirements` (Curator, Guide, Auditor); Builder/Doctor/Judge fail closed with 78 until the guarded-tools follow-up flips the manifest with evidence. A **role-tagged** (guarded) launch must fail closed in `native_tools::provision::configure` with a diagnostic naming the follow-up, rather than launching with Kimi's unguarded builtin tools.
5. **Exit-code mapping** — `75` → `RECOVERABLE` (retry with backoff); `1` needs output patterns to split `TOKEN_EXPIRED` / `TOKEN_EXHAUSTED` / `FATAL`, which belong to the account-pool follow-up. Do not guess patterns here (the Codex-table rule in `runtime-adapters.md` §3).
6. **Docs** — adapter-status row in `defaults/docs/runtime-adapters.md`; a "Kimi Code CLI" section in `defaults/docs/runtime-model-trials.md` (tested version, install, `LOOM_KIMI_BIN`, trial commands, the `-p`/`--yolo` incompatibility, `KIMI_CODE_HOME` note); `spawn-worker`'s "native: pi opencode" diagnostic string gains `kimi`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Rust tests: `Harness::parse("kimi")`, command translation for config-alias and env-family profiles (exact argv + env keys, no secret values), effort validation, `--dangerously-skip-permissions` no-op, missing binary → 127, unknown worker option → 78, role-tagged launch → 78 with a diagnostic.
- [ ] Admission tests: `--role curator --runtime kimi` passes; `--role builder --runtime kimi` and `--role judge --runtime kimi` exit 78.
- [ ] `LOOM_RUNTIME=kimi loom-daemon spawn-worker -- --profile <kimi profile> --log /tmp/kimi-trial.log -p '…'` runs a read/edit/test task in a disposable checkout with the operator's Kimi credential; a receipt under `docs/experiments/` records `kimi --version`, the observed model id, event counts and the independent test result (same shape as `native-harness-canary-2026-09-19.json`). Exit status alone is not evidence.
- [ ] `# LOOM_LAUNCH` record names `runtime: kimi`, provider, model, profile, effort; no credential value anywhere in the log.
- [ ] Docs updated as in scope item 6; `.loom/docs` resync unaffected (consumer path is `defaults/docs/` → `.loom/docs/`).

## Non-goals (filed separately)

Guarded `loom_*` tool binding and Builder/Doctor/Judge admission; `AccountProvider::Kimi` / `KIMI_CODE_HOME` rotation and exhaustion patterns; per-session usage attribution and fleet-feed badge (#8507); running Kimi in the per-sweep ephemeral container (#8403 analog); where Kimi sits in the ordered runtime preference (#8436).

## Relationships

Follows the shape of #8362 (Pi/OpenCode adapters) and #8402 (profile schema). Related: #4167 (adapter contract epic), #8506 (E2BIG argv prompts), #8436 (runtime preference), #5605/#5607 (provider-qualified account identity).
---

## Curator Enhancement

### Affected Files

- `loom-daemon/src/worker_spawn/harness.rs` — add `Harness::Kimi` (bin override `LOOM_KIMI_BIN`, name `kimi`, `is_native: true`, command translation, effort validation, `--dangerously-skip-permissions` no-op)
- `defaults/model-profiles.json` — add a `kimi` provider binding (config-alias example + Moonshot API-key example, no account values)
- `loom-daemon/src/worker_spawn/credential.rs` — confirm the "no pool" credential ladder case covers the config-alias (harness-own-auth-store) profile
- `loom-daemon/src/runtime_admission.rs` — register `defaults/runtimes/kimi.json` in `BUNDLED_RUNTIME_MANIFESTS`
- `defaults/runtimes/kimi.json` (new) — honest manifest: `worktreeIsolation`/`loomControl`/`mcp`/`subagents`/`hooks` all `"no"` for this slice
- `loom-daemon/src/native_tools/provision.rs` (or equivalent `configure` entry point) — role-tagged (guarded) launch must fail closed with a diagnostic naming the guarded-tools follow-up (#8562), not launch with Kimi's unguarded builtin tools
- `defaults/docs/runtime-adapters.md` — adapter-status row for Kimi
- `defaults/docs/runtime-model-trials.md` — new "Kimi Code CLI" section (tested version, install, `LOOM_KIMI_BIN`, trial commands, `-p`/`--yolo` incompatibility, `KIMI_CODE_HOME` note)
- `docs/experiments/` (new receipt file, canary-run evidence, same shape as `native-harness-canary-2026-09-19.json`)
- `defaults/scripts/spawn-worker.sh` (or wherever the "native: pi opencode" diagnostic string lives) — extend to include `kimi`

### Test Plan

- [ ] Automated tests: `Harness::parse("kimi")`, command translation for both the config-alias and env-family (`KIMI_MODEL_*`) profiles (assert exact argv + env keys, **no secret values** in either), effort validation against Kimi's five levels (fail 78 on anything else), `--dangerously-skip-permissions` no-op, missing binary → exit 127, unknown worker option → exit 78, role-tagged (guarded-role) launch → exit 78 with a diagnostic naming the follow-up
- [ ] Automated tests: admission — `--role curator --runtime kimi` passes; `--role builder --runtime kimi` and `--role judge --runtime kimi` exit 78
- [ ] Manual verification: live canary — `LOOM_RUNTIME=kimi loom-daemon spawn-worker -- --profile <kimi profile> --log /tmp/kimi-trial.log -p '…'` runs a read/edit/test task in a disposable checkout with a real Kimi credential; record a receipt under `docs/experiments/` (`kimi --version`, observed model id, event counts, independent test result) — exit status alone is not sufficient evidence
- [ ] Manual verification: `# LOOM_LAUNCH` record names `runtime: kimi`, provider, model, profile, effort, with no credential value anywhere in the log
- [ ] Edge cases: confirm the E2BIG prompt-delivery evaluation (item 2 in Scope) is actually run — if stdin (`--input-format=stream-json`) works headless, prefer it and record the finding on #8506; if not, document why `-p` argv was kept despite #8506's precedent

<!-- loom:complexity=complex -->

**Why `complex`, not `routine`**: this is a net-new runtime adapter touching credential handling (secrets must never leak to argv/launch-record/logs — the issue's own #8402 callout) and fail-closed admission control (a guarded role must never silently run with Kimi's unguarded builtin tools). Both are cases where a subtle mistake could pass a hastily-written test and only surface later as a credential leak or an unguarded Builder/Doctor/Judge launch — a materially higher cost-of-being-wrong than an ordinary adapter wiring task. Full rationale and duplicate-check disposition in the enhancement comment below.
title: Add a Rust Kimi Code CLI harness adapter (LOOM_RUNTIME=kimi): headless launch, model-profile binding, honest manifest, live canary
